runtime: TFLite reference kernels, firmware quantization, five-inference rolling mean

training_pronunciation_coverage_audit.note: Rows include synthetic pitch/tempo variants; they are not independent speakers. Text coverage does not prove each generated waveform's pronunciation.

privacy: Recordings remain private and evaluation-only; no training, threshold tuning, augmentation for training or model selection used household recordings.
limitations: One adult heldout speaker, only three positives; no real child target recordings. Seventeen earlier live trials saved detection metadata, not audio, used V7B and lack per-trial speaker assignment. These cannot be re-scored as recordings with V8D.
next_data_requirement: Treat both Mandarin ni hao pi2 ku4 and mixed-language ni hao Pikoo / pi1 ku1 as accepted variants. Build training and development data from public or synthetic sources, with distinct source speakers and session splits; household audio remains test-only. Do not choose a replacement using this heldout result.
